newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila stocks end down on foreign fund selling.
newsitem.headline: Manila stocks end down on foreign fund selling.

text.p: * Index recovers from day low of 3,091.56
Manila stock ended lower but off the day's low as a selldown, particularly in property stocks, continued on Monday, brokers said.
The main index closed down 10.32 points (0.32 pct) at 3,121.03, recovering from a low of 3,091.56.
A fall in property stocks led by bluechip Ayala Land was arrested in late trading, brokers said.
Ayala Land recovered from a low of 28.50 pesos to close at 29.50, down 50 centavos from the previous close.
The stock was pushed down by a belief a real estate boom might be fizzling out and also because a major foreign fund was liquidating its portfolio, one broker said.
The stock was bought in late trading by two brokerages and market talk was that the selling was linked to the company's issue of long term commercial paper which is convertible into shares.
The conversion price will be based on the market price of the stock, they said.
